summary: All 51 requirements implemented and traced (15 Java files, 148 trace entries). Thirteen points are not settled by the requirements: the -1 'none' index (encoded as 0), defaults and formula for CPA, the HCM velocity conflict, the unspecified CAM manoeuvre, and transition ordering.

issues.title: "-1 means no obstacle" conflicts with the natural-number type of cstc/cdyn
issues.raw: LRE-Var5/LRE-Var6 call cstc and cdyn natural numbers yet use -1 for 'none'; LRE-DM5/OP3/OP4 have closestStaticIndex()/closestDynamicIndex() return -1. The Java profile maps int to nat and forbids negative sentinels.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented NO_OBSTACLE = 0 as the 'none' index; ObstacleRegister/Sensor.putObstacle reject index 0, so registered obstacles are indexed from 1. Confirm 0-as-none is acceptable or give another encoding.

issues.title: Value of the 'safe large distance' for absent obstacles
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 (and OP2, OP5) say the distance functions return 'a safe large distance' when no obstacle exists, without a value.
issues.fix_directive: Chose NO_OBSTACLE_DIST = 1000000.0 m, returned by hdist/vdist/odist for any index with no obstacle. Confirm or supply a value.

issues.title: HCM advised velocity: 0 m/s (LRE-FR3) vs 0.1 m/s (system description)
issues.raw: LRE-FR3: 'On entering HCM, the LRE advises a velocity of 0 m/s'. System description: 'HCM: Reduced speed (0.1 m/s)'.
issues.fix_directive: Followed the requirement: HCM_VEL = 0.0. If 0.1 m/s is intended, note that the model's constants interface rounds fractional constants up (0.1 -> 1).

issues.title: CPA formula for cda and tcpa
issues.raw: LRE-OP5 names cda and tcpa but gives no formula. Accessors exist only for horizontal position and velocity.
issues.fix_directive: Horizontal-plane CPA. p = (nsRelDist, ewRelDist), closing velocity c = AUV velocity - obstacle velocity; tcpa = (p.c)/(|c|^2 + CPA_EPSILON); cda = sqrt(hdist^2 - tcpa*(p.c)). Using hdist (not |p|) makes the sensor's large-distance default give cda = large and tcpa = 0 when there is no dynamic obstacle, so no CAM entry. Vertical separation and obs_roc are not used. Confirm the formula and whether CPA should be 3-D.

issues.title: CPA_EPSILON keeps the CPA denominator non-zero; it is rounded to 1 in the model
issues.raw: compute() bodies admit no branching, so a zero closing velocity (relatively stationary obstacle, or no dynamic obstacle with the AUV stopped) would divide by zero.
issues.fix_directive: Added CPA_EPSILON = 0.000000000001 (m/s)^2 to the denominator; in Java it inflates cda^2 by about eps*hdist^2/|c|^2 (negligible). The constants interface rounds it up to 1, so in the model tcpa keeps its sign but cda is larger than in Java. Guards Beh8/Beh14/Beh18 depend on cda; review whether this model deviation matters.

issues.title: CheckOPEZ and CalcCPA read the closest index from the sensor, not from CalcCStc/CalcCDyn
issues.raw: LRE-OP2 says CheckOPEZ uses the index computed by CalcCStc; LRE-OP5 says CalcCPA uses cdyn. The operation profile lets compute() use only sensor calls and its own fields.
issues.fix_directive: CheckOPEZ uses sensor.odist(sensor.closestStaticIndex()); CalcCPA uses sensor.closestDynamicIndex(). Within one step these equal cstc and cdyn (same sensor snapshot, deterministic selection).

issues.title: Transition priority within each mode
issues.raw: All LRE-Beh requirements have priority 8; no order is given.
issues.fix_directive: Order used: reqOCM first (override in MOM/HCM/CAM), then inOpez, endTask, collision (CAM), HCM conditions Beh9, Beh11, Beh10, then reqHCM; in HCM: reqOCM, inOpez, CAM, back to MOM. Later branches conjoin the negation of earlier guard-only branches. Beh11 is placed before Beh10 because with staticObsVertDist = staticObsDfltVertDist = 1, Beh10 subsumes Beh11 and Beh11 would never be enabled.

issues.title: CAM's evasive manoeuvre is not specified
issues.raw: LRE-FR4: 'the AUV performs evasive manoeuvres' with no advised velocity or heading.
issues.fix_directive: Entering CAM issues no output; the last advice stays in force until CAM is left (Beh17, or Beh18 with advVel(0)). Specify the CAM outputs if any are required.

issues.title: vvel is the signed rate of climb
issues.raw: LRE-OP1: 'vvel is the rate of climb'; LRE-Beh11 tests vvel >= 1 m/s.
issues.fix_directive: Followed literally: vvel = rate_of_climb (signed), so Beh11 fires only when climbing. A fast descent towards a static obstacle is caught only by Beh10 (vdist <= staticObsDfltVertDist). Confirm, or use |rate_of_climb|.

issues.title: Thresholds written as literals in the requirements became named constants
issues.raw: LRE-Beh4 uses 'vel <= 1' and 'odist > 1'; LRE-Beh9/Beh11 use '1 m/s'; LRE-Beh7/Beh18 'advVel(0)'; LRE-OP2 'depth at or below zero'; LRE-Beh8/Beh14 'tcpa non-negative'.
issues.fix_directive: Introduced MOM_ENTRY_MAX_VEL, MOM_ENTRY_MIN_DIST, HIGH_HORIZ_VEL, HIGH_VERT_VEL, STOP_VEL, SURFACE_DEPTH, MIN_TCPA rather than reusing MIN_SAFE_DIST or MOM_VEL, since the requirements state bare numbers.

issues.title: Variables live in the operation classes; operations run at the top of step()
issues.raw: LRE-Var1..Var8 say 'the controller maintains' each variable; LRE-OP1..OP5 say the controller invokes each operation before evaluating guards.
issues.fix_directive: Each variable is a field of the operation that computes it, read through a getter of the same name; step() calls CalcVel, CalcCStc, CheckOPEZ, CalcCDyn, CalcCPA compute() before declaring the predicates.

issues.title: Events without a transition in the current mode are ignored
issues.raw: LRE-Beh19 settles OCM; the requirements do not say what endTask or reqHCM do in HCM/CAM, or reqMOM outside OCM. LRE-DC1 forbids duplicate transitions per mode and trigger, yet several trigger-less transitions leave MOM.
issues.fix_directive: Unhandled events are ignored (no branch). step(null) means no operator input this cycle. DC1 read as one branch per behavioural requirement; the trigger-less MOM transitions differ by guard.

issues.title: Closest-obstacle ties and record component names
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 does not say which index wins a tie in closestStaticIndex/closestDynamicIndex.
issues.fix_directive: Ties go to the lowest index. The Obstacle record keeps the requirement's names (ns_rel_dist, ...) so that its fields do not share names with the Sensor accessors (nsRelDist, ...).

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile, coverage, profile check, transformations, FDR4/Dafny/Isabelle, vacuity) and review the uncertain items above alongside its reports.
